hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Riser spool
function: The flanged spool between the BOP and the stripper that gives the bottomhole assembly a place to sit above the rams when the coil is pulled up.

tabs.overview: Length set by the longest BHA plus a margin so the rams can close on bare coil with the tools above them.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the stack; flanged both ends.
tabs.safety: A BHA parked in the riser is above the rams; the stripper is the only seal until the rams are closed on the coil above the BHA.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
